body.statement: Fix \(\rho\in I\), a realized dataset \(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho}\), and \(C=C_n(\rho)\) with \(p_{\mathrm{ref}}(n,C,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)>0\). Under \(\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}\), every history in \(\Omega_{n,C}(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)\) is imputable for \(X'\), \(C'\), \(R'_1\), \(R'_2\), and \(T'\). Conversely, every quota-respecting chronological holdout--assignment history on which these statistics are imputable and whose recomputed complete signed cell equals \(C\) belongs to \(\Omega_{n,C}(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)\). Therefore this explicit support is exactly the same-cell imputability support, with no additional conditioning event.
body.justification: The explicit support removes ambiguity about which histories are rerandomized and which quantities are recomputed after selection.
body.gap: Freidling, Zhao, and Gao give the abstract conditional reference representation under imputability; this lemma identifies that support combinatorially for the present holdout and complete-cell design.
body.consumer: Exact implementations can enumerate the reference law without an unspecified fiber or hidden conditioning restriction.
